findings.explanation: HOL4 introduces CARD by new_specification with only CARD {} = 0 and the INSERT equation for FINITE s. Its value on infinite sets is unspecified; pred_setScript.sml:3613 notes that `SING s <=> (CARD s = 1)` cannot be proved. The Lean definition has `else 0`, so Lean proves CARD s = 0 for every infinite s, for example CARD (UNIV : Set Nat) = 0, and also the unprovable SING equivalence. Finite sets agree.
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Basic

theorem auditBound : ∀ l : List Nat, ∃ b : Nat, ∀ x, x ∈ l → x < b := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, fun x h => absurd h (by simp)⟩
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨a + b + 1, fun x h => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h | h
    · omega
    · have := hb x h
      omega

theorem auditCard : CARD (UNIV : Set Nat) = 0 := by
  have h : ¬ FINITE (UNIV : Set Nat) := by
    intro hf
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := auditBound l
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl b (hb b (hl b True.intro))
  unfold CARD
  exact if_neg h
findings.hol4_check: ?C:(num -> bool) -> num. (C {} = 0) /\ (!s. FINITE s ==> !x. C (x INSERT s) = if x IN s then C s else SUC (C s)) /\ (C univ(:num) = 1)
